## About the portfolio site

The portfolio is a single-page site with five parts: a hero with four headline metrics, an About & Competencies section, 10 featured case studies, a career timeline and a contact section with a resume viewer. Each case study opens in a popup on the same page, so there are no separate URLs per project. The original project files for each case study are linked below.

## Skills

**Analytics & Modeling**: Power BI and DAX (star schema, time-intelligence measures, Power Query), PostgreSQL and DBeaver (constraints, staging and upsert pipelines), financial and ratio modeling (3-step DuPont ROE, common-size analysis, forecasting), operations research (Dijkstra's shortest path, queuing theory, network optimization), advanced Excel (XLOOKUP, dynamic arrays, pivots, scenario modeling).

**Strategy & Operations**: business analysis (BRD, user stories with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria), process flow and system architecture (flowcharts, swimlanes, ERD in MS Visio and draw.io), capacity and bottleneck planning, workflow automation (Power Automate), UAT and defect management (traceability matrix, test scenarios, root-cause analysis).

**Product & Consulting**: market sizing and segmentation, 0-to-1 venture incubation, agile project management (JIRA, Confluence, Critical Path Method), curriculum and program design, executive stakeholder presentations.

## The 10 featured case studies

### 1. Performance Management Redesign (KPI Dashboards), Growth Central VC
- **Period**: August 2021 to August 2022 | **Role**: Core Team Member, sole owner of the business analysis lifecycle and systems
- **Problem**: recruiter performance was tracked by raw counts, then by productivity ratios that led to arguments over candidate attribution. Weekly data arrived in inconsistent spreadsheets with no deduplication or trend analysis.
- **What was built**: a formal BRD and 13 user stories across 5 JIRA epics; a PostgreSQL schema with integrity constraints; a DBeaver upsert pipeline; a Power BI dashboard with team and group slicers and custom DAX time-intelligence.
- **Scoring formula (V3)**: `Total Score = 5A + 2B - 6C + 10D - 4E` where E = C - D, balancing sourcing effort against interview quality. The model went through 3 iterations.
- **Results**: 22 UAT test cases run, 20 passed; 2 high-severity defects caught in UAT (an alphabetical MIN bug on status bands and an inverted sign on negative week-over-week denominators).
- **Tools**: Power BI, DAX, PostgreSQL, DBeaver, JIRA, Confluence, draw.io, Excel data validation
- **Project files**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1E0fjcqQyj1njvmEVz1gaQTCQxVTi6KXG?usp=sharing

### 2. New Product Line Launch: Expert-Led Courses & PM Program, Growth Central VC
- **Period**: October 2021 to January 2022 | **Role**: Core Team Member (product layout, operations and tech platform)
- **Problem**: the company had a single commercial product (skill assessment tests and certificates) and needed more revenue streams.
- **What was built**: 4 self-paced expert courses (Finance, Marketing, CS, Cyber Security) with domain experts of 10+ years, plus a live 8-week Product Management cohort program built around a 6-week management internship, designed and taught by Kshitiz.
- **Results**: ₹3,00,000 in Q1 revenue (₹2,50,000 from the 4 courses and ₹50,000 from the PM program); 85% completion rate; enrollment grew from 60+ to 100+ students in 6 months; 40% of PM cohort completers moved into paid internship placements.
- **Project files**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15ItsVQvv72Q8pxY_UCPCky_MAtwJQxsA?usp=sharing

### 3. Forecasting Model & Capacity Bottleneck Analysis, Gyasi Ram & Sons
- **Period**: July 2024 to April 2025 | **Role**: Assistant Manager, Business Operations & Analytics
- **Problem**: seasonal demand surges from July to September caused repeated stockouts and customer waits of 20+ minutes.
- **What was built**: an Excel forecasting model for 54 SKUs and a map of the 3-workstation manufacturing pipeline.
- **Results**: 2025 demand of 483,840 units against a manufacturing limit of 394,230, leaving 96,070 units (20%) of unmet demand; the cutting and singeing workstation hit 312% utilization in August; Q1 forecast validated at 2.1% MAPE (28,980 forecast vs 29,526 actual units); customer interaction time cut from 20 to 12-13 minutes and average basket size raised from 2-3 to 4-5 products.
- **Tools**: time-and-motion study, Excel forecasting, bottleneck analysis, MAPE and bias tracking
- **Project files**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Cnw8zzNfQA4ox7DDNKdSU2cmAR72SbfE?usp=sharing

### 4. Electric Vehicle Market Entry Strategy & Infrastructure, Maruti Suzuki XCELerate 2023
- **Period**: August to October 2023 | **Role**: Semi-Finalist
- **Result**: Top 10 in the B-School track (Top 20 overall) from 51,866 registrants across India.
- **What was built**: an EV market-entry strategy covering charging station density, consumer psychography, price-tier targeting (mid-range focus at ₹9-15 lakh), launch state selection and a repositioning campaign for Maruti Suzuki's EV, plus a competitor positioning matrix and a 4-tier risk mitigation matrix.
- **Tools**: market sizing, competitive benchmarking, infrastructure analytics, executive deck design
- **Project files**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Y4JsfUDt3EnKaZFjGPqmZ8gyk8Yd7gOA?usp=sharing

### 5. Daikoku: Two-Sided Marketplace & Startup Incubation, Atal Incubation Centre (SNU)
- **Period**: June to December 2022 | **Role**: Co-Founder (operations, strategy and marketing lead)
- **Problem**: undergraduate students lack project experience, and early-stage startups lack pre-evaluated talent.
- **What was done**: customer discovery survey of 53 students (79.2% willing to do real projects); outreach to 21 early-stage startups; pitch decks for the incubator.
- **Results**: 13 of 21 startups converted into meetings (62%); ₹23,000 early revenue from a website-development engagement; coordinated 4 co-founders across operations, web development, XR/Unity and marketing.
- **Project files**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18bxVORw4bbdf9egULvmRO9jpvWs-sm2a?usp=sharing

### 6. FluorCo Growth Diagnostic & Queuing Model, Bain Capability Network (BrAINWARS 2023)
- **Period**: September to October 2023 | **Role**: Team Member
- **Problem**: a 50-year-old hydrofluoric acid firm stagnated despite strong company growth.
- **What was built**: a MECE issue tree and a queuing model (Little's Law) showing 4 compounding root causes. Fixed costs were not the margin driver; volatile plant utilization and costly fluorspar imports pushed unit costs to $38,900 per case against $25,000 for peers. The model moves utilization from 64% to 90%.
- **Result**: cleared Round 1 of Bain's national case competition and advanced to Round 2, with 5 prioritized recommendations (supplier diversification, category mix, regional expansion, brand investment).
- **Project files**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1pphCi7QIauoZzM-nZT1Ap68F4HRjBBX9?usp=sharing

### 7. Campus Recruitment & Internship Hiring Pipeline, Growth Central VC
- **Period**: March to August 2022 | **Role**: Core Team Member (recruitment function lead)
- **What was done**: led campus recruitment across 5 institutions (LPU, KMC, DDUC, DTU E-Cell, IIM Rohtak ArthaShastra) and set up standardized screening guides and interview criteria.
- **Results**: 100+ applicants sourced, 60+ interviews, 15 interns onboarded, 33% post-internship conversion (5 of 15 retained).
- **Project files**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1oj0j8ZzqvzmWg71Q0JiiH7YsU6WdiT5W?usp=sharing

### 8. Market Research: Competitor Landscape Study, Growth Central VC
- **Period**: July to August 2021 | **Role**: Product Management Intern (led 7 research interns)
- **What was done**: mapped 200+ competitors across course learning and skill certification in 3 weeks (50% faster than the target) using the Critical Path Method, with customer surveys and pricing sensitivity analysis.
- **Result**: validated the case for course learning as the company's second product line; the founder offered a core team role afterwards.
- **Project files**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gmf_nS38Z3pBir0P0YGzLLreZ6S93lau?usp=sharing

### 9. EMS Route Optimization & Performance Management, DOM208 Operations Research
- **Period**: November 2022 | **Role**: Lead Researcher
- **What was built**: ambulance routing modeled as a weighted directed graph, solved with Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm, extended to bipartite matching for multi-ambulance dispatch, plus a KPI framework (response time, turnaround time, ambulance utilization, distance efficiency).
- **Result**: 10% gain in distance efficiency (0.90 to 1.00), which is 2 minutes saved per round trip, or 48+ minutes across 24 daily trips.
- **Project files**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-_HfoAcBc3YtDqia0iVg3oyggPED12UL?usp=sharing

### 10. Godrej Consumer Products: DuPont Analysis & Forecast, FAC105 Financial Accounting
- **Period**: November 2021 | **Role**: Lead Analyst
- **What was built**: an 11-year review (FY2012 to FY2022) with horizontal and vertical analysis, ratio analysis, 3-step DuPont ROE decomposition and a 2-year forecast in Excel.
- **Findings**: the FY2019 ROE spike (35.6%) came from a one-off tax credit of ₹282 crore, not operations; raw material costs rose from 34.7% of revenue in FY18 to 43.6% in FY22; fixed asset turnover improved from 2.55x to 4.78x; the company is debt-free (0.00x debt-to-equity).
- **Project files**: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-_HfoAcBc3YtDqia0iVg3oyggPED12UL?usp=sharing
